_doc: The SARIF log's TWO orderings, in a document where they disagree. The
advisory OWN050 is at the first line and the leaks after it, so the results
run OWN050, OWN001, OWN001 in the bridge's own order (BR-V8) while the rule
catalogue must run OWN001, OWN050 — sorted and deduplicated. A log that
sorted its results, or left its catalogue in encounter order, or listed
OWN001 twice, all read plausibly and are all wrong.
